item.jaymospowers.chain_axe.whirl: Hold right-click to whirl the axe head on its chain; let go to bring it down where you look
jei.jaymospowers.chain_axe: An axe head on a length of chain. Hold right click to whirl it round you, and let go to bring it down where you look: whoever it bites is hooked and tugged toward you. Sneak as it lands to drag them all the way in. Forged at the Tool Station from a Chain Axe Head, a Tool Handle and an iron chain.
